question: Why does the Lord stress the rarity and weight of this knowledge?
premises: Royal sages knew the tradition-received yoga.
It was lost in great time.
Even lineage-obtained knowledge is now lost.
inference: The Lord reveals the rarity and gravity of this knowledge.
uncertainties: The numeral token is retained as given.
plain_english: Thus royal sages knew this tradition-received yoga, but it was lost in great time, scorcher of foes; and though obtained by teacher lineage, it is now lost; by this the Lord shows the rarity and weight of this knowledge.
